text:
anya: Quick one — bagels + boardgames this Thu 9:30am? Farmer's Stand van outside HQ. Who's in?
samir: Love it. Count me in. I'll bring Codenames + a small speaker.
tess: In! Can someone bring vegan options? I'm dairy-free.
maria: I'll grab a tray of sesame bagels from the van. Any spreads requests? :bagel:
kai: Can we move to 9:15? My standup runs late sometimes.
anya: 9:15 works for me — updated on my side. Anyone have foldable tables? We have one in conf B but might need another.
devon: I can bring a foldable table and extra chairs. Also bringing Uno for the nostalgia crowd.
samir: Also quick FYI: parking near the van is limited. Suggest bikes/walk.
gcal-bot: Event created: Bagels & Boardgames — Thu 09:15–10:30 • RSVP link: https://gcal.app/event/abc123
jordan: RSVP'ed. @tess I'll grab a vegan schmear from the bakery stall — want almond or hummus?
tess: Almond pls, thanks! :heart:
anya: Awesome. I'll post a quick note in #general tomorrow morning for visibility. If anyone wants to join virtually for coffee, I'll drop the Zoom link.
maria: :thumbsup: I can bring napkins and cutlery. Who's on cleanup?
devon: Cleanup crew: me + samir + maria. We got it.
anya: Perfect — see you Thursday. If the weather looks bad I'll update here by 7am. :sun_with_face:
